claims.text: Role in RDS: delivery b4 34 wk → betamethasone or dexamethasone to the preg pt b4 delivery induces fetal surfactant and ↓RDS risk or severity.
claims.quote: When a fetus must be delivered before 34 weeks gestation, giving the pregnant patient betamethasone or dexamethasone before delivery induces fetal surfactant production and reduces the risk of RDS or decreases its severity (1).
claims.locator: Prevention of Respiratory Distress Syndrome in Neonates

claims.text: Betamethasone 12 mg IM q24h × 2 doses (or dexamethasone 6 mg IM q12h × 4 doses)
claims.quote: One of the following corticosteroids may be used: - Betamethasone 12 mg IM every 24 hours for 2 doses - Dexamethasone 6 mg IM every 12 hours for 4 doses
